title: Amar Prem
desc: Subho and Deepika struggle to unite owing to Deepika's father who disapproves of Subho. Meanwhile, her father betroths her to an evil man who is only interested in their family's property.

title: Loafer
desc: Bikram is a selfless man who is unfairly hated by his family. However, after an arrest for helping a friend marry, he struggles to gain the respect of those he constantly protects.

title: Mangaldeep
desc: Two best friends, Mangal and Deep, embark on a journey to the big city to fulfil their musical dreams. In his quest to see Deep succeed, Mangal risks everything, including his own finances.

title: Takkar
desc: Chaitali, a rich girl, marries Arun against her family's wishes. Soon, their relationship turns sour and the bone of contention between the couple is the man's nephew.
